mechanism_and_quality_notes: A small approved moth reference points once to a larger editable-path specimen with three meaningful edit nodes. The right paired checks use the same conceptual moth geometry on visibly light and dark surfaces, and a tiny lower specimen makes the size check concrete. Same SVG is grouped with the theme pair. State destination and the first-party-evidence caveat are detached notes with no causal guides. All seven labels occur once; article prose was removed. At 320px the reference/editability/theme/size relationship remains visible. Actual dominant topology is a horizontal-strip with unequal central mass and subordinate lower size test, not the original planned radial-loop. It is the only horizontal-strip in this set, so the observed six-family mix satisfies diversity without relabeling. All foreground is comfortably inside 40px.
